source_checks.conclusion: For Turkish, the enum kind selects a map; the full unchanged English source selects a record; the requested movement ID must be in that record’s approved set. There is no fuzzy matching, substring translation, or unguarded global fallback in this helper.

source_checks.conclusion: notMeasured requests its own kind and actual movement ID. Unmatched strings retain the existing honesty-copy path. The historical session-summary/cue statements therefore have explicit catalogue context in source layout.

source_checks.conclusion: Labels and cues use separate enum kinds with the actual movement ID. The existing section is about what rules look for. Configured-live closed-release copy explicitly states camera/feedback/form score are unavailable; non-live copy says the rules are written and do not run. The change translates existing text, and does not evaluate rules, start a camera, or introduce new movement instructions.

source_checks.property: no capability, curriculum or storage mutation
source_checks.conclusion: Source change consists of display lookup/wiring and the queue context note. Camera start remains behind the unchanged release policy.
